'''Xonolite''' was a metal found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The [[Jawenko lava beast]] could easily transform xonolite from its natural solid state to liquid. [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] were known to export liquid xonolite to [[Nkllon/Legends|Nkllon]], where it was sold as [[Nkllonian lava extract]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|343}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues]]'' spells this metal as "'''xolonite'''."
